766710101.text: Where could they be? Ugh, this is turning into a major headache...

766710102.text: What now, Boss? Forget our brothers and sisters over at the lighthouse, waiting to get to work... If we don't have enough fuel, it's lights out for the entire camp.

766710103.text: Yeah. We gotta think of something, Squad Leader.

766710105.text: Head back to your posts. I'll take care of this.

766710107.text: Hey there, Illuga. Why's everyone gathered here at the entrance?

766710110.text: Eh, it's fine. Just a minor issue, really, and I'm already on the case.

766710111.text: Aw, c'mon Illuga! You're always trying to fix things by yourself on the down low. Just tell us, it couldn't hurt!

766710112.text: Or is it 'cause you're too embarrassed to say?

766710113.text: Haha, no way. I just don't want everyone in town worrying about things that I can handle on my own.

766710114.text: But since you're both part of the investigation squad now, I won't treat you like outsiders.

766710115.text: Still, this isn't exactly the place for a chat. Come on in, I'll tell you more inside.

766710201.text: Y'know, Paimon's been wanting to ask for a while now... What are these vehicle thingies we keep seeing in the Lightkeepers' camps? They kinda look like food trucks, don'cha think?

766710202.text: It'd be awesome if you really could cook up there, but Paimon has a feeling there's more to these things than meets the eye...

766710204.text: Uhh... What? Yeah, that wasn't what Paimon was getting at...

766710207.text: Oh, these? Officially, they're called "Moonwagons." They're transportation tools we made by modifying Snezhnayan mechanical vehicles.

766710208.text: You can think of them as kuuvahki-powered mobile lighthouses.

766710209.text: They're not quick by any means, but they save us a whole lot of trouble and manpower when it comes to transporting supplies.

766710210.text: As for cooking functionality, I hadn't actually given that any thought. But you know, if we did install a toaster in there...

766710206.text: For real? You mean the type that'd grab a spoon and start attacking you if you said you didn't like its cooking?

subQuests.subQuestName: Check on the person crying for help

766710601.text: S—Squad Leader! Thank the gods, you're here! Please, help me!

766710602.text: Valdis... How did you end up here?

766710603.text: It's... a long story. But the barrier created by these Mandragoras can't be broken from inside, so I've been stuck in here for almost the whole day!

766710604.text: Hmm, something about this doesn't quite add up. This place isn't on the main road from Piramida, nor is it some sort of shortcut.

766710605.text: And as for the Mandragoras, they wouldn't usually bother passers-by unless they were trespassing on their territory.

766710606.text: In short, I'd like an explanation as to how you ended up here — and a reasonable one, at that, or you might have to stay in there a while longer.

766710607.text: Whoa, you don't usually see Illuga getting angry... Paimon's kinda scared now, too.

766710610.text: That's true... Guess being an adventurer really does have its advantages. It's a good thing we're only honorary squad members, or we'd be subject to his discipline, too.

766710611.text: Agh... Alright, alright. Last night, I found the path to our camp blocked by a large group of Mandragoras.

766710612.text: You know how I like studying insects and plants, Squad Leader... and it was such a rare sight to see this many Mandragoras gathered in one place.

766710613.text: I didn't wanna miss the opportunity, so I followed them all the way here. But then...

766710614.text: Ahh, I'm so sorry! I'll take responsibility for this, I promise. How about... I cover night watch for the coming week? No, make that the whole month!

766710501.text: Alrighty. That's the issue resolved, and our fuel stocks replenished. Thank you both very much.

766710502.text: Ah, don't mention it! We're part of the team, right?

766710503.text: Speaking of the team, how's Valdis doing?

766710504.text: Hmm. He neglected his duty while escorting a supply shipment, which is a violation of our regulations.

766710505.text: However, he did encounter a pretty dangerous situation related to the Wild Hunt, and we didn't end up suffering any losses.

766710506.text: As such, as per his wishes, he'll be responsible for protecting the lighthouse throughout its next month of construction.

766710507.text: Hmph, hope he doesn't start slacking off again. Now that she's a member of the team, Paimon's gonna start coming down to check up on him — oh, and to see how the lighthouse is coming along, too!

766710508.text: Speaking of which... Paimon wonders what it'll look like once it's all done.

766710509.text: It won't be as impressive as the one at Final Night Cemetery, that's for sure. Still, it'll be bright enough to serve as a beacon to guide travelers through the night.

766710510.text: So long as we're able to keep people safe, whether from the Wild Hunt or anything else, our efforts will not have been in vain.

766710511.text: Anyway, I should go back to sorting through our archives. All that work isn't gonna do itself...

766710514.text: Don't worry, we won't be this busy forever. We should be able to put our feet up a bit once this place is up and running.

766710515.text: In that case, we'll help you out! That way, it'll be done in no time!

766710516.text: Your help would be most welcome, believe me! But... I'm sure you've got a lot on your plate already. And asking you to come all this way just to do our work for us... it wouldn't feel right.

766710517.text: Hmm... How about this, then? If you find anything useful during your adventures and you happen to be passing by, feel free to drop it off.

766710518.text: C'mon, it's no biggie! Like you said, we're squadmates now, hehe!

766710520.text: Haha... In that case, let me say again that it's an honor to have you as my squadmates.

766710401.text: Whew. Finally drove off those monsters...

766710402.text: What's going on here? Surely they couldn't have been waiting in ambush this whole time...?

766710403.text: The Wild Hunt... The Mandragoras... Ah, I get it.

766710404.text: Huh? Have you figured something out, Illuga?

766710405.text: Valdis, I think these Mandragoras trapped you inside the barrier to protect you.

766710406.text: They're very sensitive to shifts in their environment. I myself heard some strange murmurs on the way here.

766710407.text: Come to think of it, it must've come from the Wild Hunt monsters, who had yet to manifest at that time.

766710408.text: These Mandragoras must have detected them very early on, which is why they barred your path and prevented you from continuing onward...

766710409.text: Only to have you follow them anyway, leaving them no choice but to trap you here for your protection.

766710410.text: I see, so that's what was going on... No wonder they refused to leave the area...

766710411.text: They probably only protected you because they detected the scent of grass and flowers on your person... perhaps because of all the time you spend around them.

766710412.text: Either way, thank you both. There doesn't seem to be any further danger.

766710413.text: Ah, there they go. Adorable little fellas, huh? And they didn't even ask for a reward!

766710414.text: Imagine if we had them around to watch our backs — we'd never have to worry about being ambushed while opening treasure chests again!

766710415.text: Y'know, putting it like that, it was kinda understandable that Valdis would wanna follow them...

766710419.text: ...I know, I know, I'm sorry... I'll take whatever's coming to me...

766710420.text: Alright. Now that we've got him out, let's head back. The others are probably starting to worry.
